Fetched: 2026-08-12, via Poly Pizza (https://poly.pizza), which hosts these
         models as .glb. Unity reads .glb through com.unity.cloud.gltfast.

| File                      | Poly Pizza page                  | Tris | Used for                        |
|---------------------------|----------------------------------|------|---------------------------------|
| Slime.glb                 | https://poly.pizza/m/LyjSUKHKnh  | 1440 | PlasticSlime (Quái Rác Nhựa)    |
| RobotEnemyFlyingGun.glb   | https://poly.pizza/m/UDTM6X1y9a  | 4582 | PollutionFlyBot                 |
| Farmer.glb                | https://poly.pizza/m/7pn3R6hPvE  | 3716 | every human NPC — Ông Sáu as-is, |
|                           |                                  |      | Bà Tư and Tí recoloured (ArtPass)|

Two other Quaternius characters (Animated Woman, Characters Sam) were tried and dropped:
Poly Pizza serves them as atlas-textured .glb **without the atlas**, so they import pure
white with no colour data anywhere — no material factors, no vertex colours. This model
carries its colours per material instead, which is why the villagers are recolours of it.

CC0 requires no attribution, but we credit anyway — see CREDITS.md at the repo
root. Do not edit these files in place; they are third-party originals.
